description: CACAO v2 playbook operationalising the per-window reconciliation of a declared segmentation policy against the observed network-boundary state on the operator's own deployed estate. Anchored to NIS2 Article 21(2)(e) (security in network and information systems) and to DORA Article 9 read against the JC RTS on ICT risk management framework (Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1774) network- security articles. The lifecycle enumerates documented network segments from the operator's declarative network-inventory sources, evaluates the segmentation-policy allowances against the observed per-segment reachability posture, detects policy violations (undocumented cross-segment reachability, unauthorised egress paths, boundary-control drift against the declared zone-transit matrix), engages the operator's pre-bound remediation surface against each violation, and generates a dated network-security- posture evidence artifact for the reconciliation window. The playbook does not author the operator's segmentation policy or the segmentation architecture itself; it operationalises a documented reconciliation posture against pre-bound segmentation sources and pre-bound remediation surfaces. Distinct from playbook.infra_posture_management@v1 which is the broader infrastructure-posture (host, workload, IAM) reconciliation engine; this playbook is the network-boundary limb only.

__automated_isolation_allowed__.description: Whether the operator's isolation posture allows automated isolation of a path carrying an active-abuse fingerprint. A real boolean; isolation is never the default.

__boundary_rules__.description: The boundary-control rules in force as a JSON list: each with its control, zone pair, service (or any) and whether it permits the transit.

__evidence_produced_at__.description: Zulu instant (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) the posture evidence is published.

__inventory_sources__.description: The network-inventory sources as a JSON list (CACAO has no list type), highest precedence first: each with its reference, its kind (declarative, provider_api or controller) and its segments, each segment with its zone, binding, address ranges, tenancy and whether it supports a critical or important function.

__observed_transits__.description: The window's observed transits as a JSON list, from the flow-log stream or reachability probes: each with its source and destination, service, first and last sighting, origin and any active-abuse fingerprint.

__policy_evaluation__.description: Envelope evaluate_segmentation_policy emits: the normalised matrix and the policy's own gaps. __policy_snapshot_id__ is extracted from it.

__policy_snapshot_id__.description: Identifier of the pinned policy snapshot, extracted from __policy_evaluation__, so the evidence names the policy revision the window was reconciled against.

__posture_evidence__.description: Envelope generate_posture_evidence_artifact emits, shaped after an OSCAL assessment result: one finding per violation with its action, no_findings for an empty window, and the open items carried forward. __posture_evidence_id__ is extracted from it.

__posture_evidence_id__.description: Identifier of the dated posture evidence for the window, extracted from __posture_evidence__. Always set, including on an empty window.

__reconciliation_window__.description: Identifier of the reconciliation window this run discharges (scheduled-cadence reference, on-demand reconciliation reference, or operator-initiated trigger). The trigger input; the wall-clock instants live on the step records.

__remediation_action_id__.description: Identifier of the remediation dispatch, extracted from __remediation_dispatch__. Unset when the violation set is empty: nothing was dispatched.

__remediation_binding__.description: The remediation surface per classification, each acl_change or posture_ticket. Defaults to the playbook's DEFAULT_BINDING: rule changes for undocumented transit and unauthorised egress, a posture ticket for boundary-control drift. CACAO carries the default as JSON text; the adapter decodes it.

__remediation_dispatch__.description: Envelope enforce_remediation emits: the binding applied and the dispatch table. __remediation_action_id__ is extracted from it.

__remediation_dispatched_at__.description: Zulu instant (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) the remediation step closed.

__remediation_dispatches__.description: One dispatch per violation as a JSON list, each with the violation, the surface and the persistent identifier that surface returned. Empty when the violation set is.

__segment_inventory__.description: Envelope inventory_network_segments emits: the segments, the undocumented ones, source disagreements and overlapping ranges. __segment_inventory_id__ is extracted from it.

__segment_inventory_id__.description: Identifier of the reconciled segment inventory, extracted from __segment_inventory__. It replays for the same window and sources.

__segmentation_policy__.description: The operator's segmentation policy: its reference and revision, the internal and external zones, the administration zone, and the zone-transit matrix with each transit allowed, denied or conditional on services or a time-boxed authorisation.

__violation_detection__.description: Envelope detect_policy_violations emits: every violation with its classification, and the compliant observation count. The set may be empty. __violation_set_id__ is extracted from it.

__violation_set_id__.description: Identifier of the window's violation set, extracted from __violation_detection__. An empty set has an identifier too, so the audit-evident chain stays closed.

action--7e750001-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Compose the window's segment inventory from the operator's network-inventory sources in its documented precedence order: infrastructure-as-code records, cloud-provider network APIs and on-premise network controllers, read-only. Where two sources report the same segment the higher one's record is kept and every field a lower one disagrees on is recorded. A segment no declarative source reports is in the estate but not in the documentation, and is listed as undocumented; overlapping ranges inside one binding are listed too. Produces __segment_inventory__, from which __segment_inventory_id__ is extracted.
action--7e750001-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: inventory_network_segments

action--7e750001-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Normalise the operator's zone-transit matrix against the inventory and pin the snapshot the window is reconciled against. Every directed zone pair is allowed, denied, or conditional on services or a time-boxed authorisation; every pair the matrix does not list is denied, within a zone as well as between zones (Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2690, Annex points 6.7.2(c) and 6.8.2(e)). The policy's own gaps are recorded. Produces __policy_evaluation__, from which __policy_snapshot_id__ is extracted.
action--7e750001-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: evaluate_segmentation_policy

action--7e750001-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Compare the observed transits and the boundary rules in force against the pinned matrix. An observed transit outside it is unauthorised_egress when the destination is an external zone and undocumented_transit otherwise; a conditional allowance holds only for its services and inside its authorisation window. A boundary rule that permits what the matrix denies or does not list, or denies what it plainly allows, is boundary_control_drift, recorded with its direction whether or not traffic was seen. Repeated sightings merge into one violation. The set may be empty. Produces __violation_detection__, from which __violation_set_id__ is extracted.
action--7e750001-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: detect_policy_violations

action--7e750001-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Record the dispatch of every violation to the operator's pre-bound remediation surface: a rule change or a posture ticket per the binding. Isolation is the short-circuit, never the default: only a violation carrying an active-abuse fingerprint, and only when the operator's posture allows automated isolation (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1774, Art. 13). The step closes only when every dispatch has returned a persistent identifier. It runs on every window; with an empty violation set it dispatches nothing. Produces __remediation_dispatch__, from which __remediation_action_id__ is extracted, unset when nothing was dispatched.
action--7e750001-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: enforce_remediation

action--7e750001-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Compose the dated posture evidence for the window, shaped after an OSCAL assessment result. The chain is checked: the policy evaluation must be of this inventory, the detection of this inventory and snapshot, and the dispatch of this violation set; a record from another window is refused. Every finding names its surface and the identifier the surface returned; an empty window says no_findings. Undocumented segments, source disagreements and the policy's own gaps are carried as open items. Produces __posture_evidence__, from which __posture_evidence_id__ is extracted.
action--7e750001-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: generate_posture_evidence_artifact
